note: City of Wayne campground at the south edge of town on Hwy 15, maintained by Public Works. Shaded small loop with a fire ring at each site; restrooms. --Claude
summary: City pages read: $15/night (deposit box; a 7/2024 RV Life review paid $15), 5-night max, 12 electrical hookups, dump ('sewer discharge area') and water hydrant - written manual. Amperage (stored 50), no-water/sewer-at-site, FCFS and 40-ft rig limit not on the city pages, left derived. Not waterfront stands; pin OK.
flags: AMPERAGE UNVERIFIED: the city's Victor Park page lists '12 electrical hookups for campers' with no amperage; stored electric 50 (from note prose '30 & 50 amp') left derived. The 7/2024 reviewer: 'Just has electric at the sites. Water is available at the check in.' (consistent with stored water/sewer false).
UNVERIFIED (derived, left): sites.max_rig_ft 40 and booking FCFS/no reservations - neither on the city pages (the payment box implies self-registration, but the pages do not say first-come).
WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: a small treed loop between Hwy 15 and farm fields; Logan Creek ~250 m south beyond houses and a trail.
PIN OK: stored 42.22618,-97.01845 is on the loop.
